notes: Cash basis. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); beginning/ending cash are the governmental fund balances (cash basis) the statement rolls forward (ending 791,342 = cash 781,028 + county treasurer 10,314 + due from 4,804 - due to 4,804, p3). Business-type from proprietary statement p6 (Water, Sewer, Electric); receipts total = operating 967,662 + non-operating 10,572. 'Sales and other taxes' categorized sales tax because the budget schedule p7 prints Sales taxes 258,250 for the same amount. The statement 'Property taxes' 299,061 equals budget property taxes-county 276,255 + motor vehicle taxes-county 22,806 (p7) but is kept as printed (property tax). Detail: governmental from the combining schedule of governmental fund departments p8 (one line per department/fund column); business-type from the proprietary statement fund columns p6 (the only other supplementary schedule, the budget-to-actual p7, combines all funds, so it is not recorded). The County Treasurer's Fund schedule p9 (cash held by the county, remitted to the city) is not recorded to avoid double counting. Balance sheet: Statement of Net Position - Cash Basis, Total column (p1). Read pages 1-9 of 9
